name: CHAPTER 2 Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting
description: This chapter is a reference for the authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) commands: The AAA feature allows you to verify the identity of, grant access to, and track the actions of users managing devices. The AAA feature works with the access control protocols as described in these chapters:

name: aaa accounting default
description: Use this command to set the AAA methods for accounting. Configure mode
syntax: no aaa accounting default ((group LINE) | local)

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Use a server group list for authentication

parameters.name: LINE
parameters.description: Specify a space-separated list of up to 8 configured RADIUS or TACACS+ server group names followed bylocal. The list can also include:

name: aaa authentication login
description: Use this command to set login authentication behavior. Configure mode

parameters.name: mschap enable
parameters.description: Enable Microsoft Challenge Handshake Authentication Protocol (MS-CHAP) authentication

name: aaa authentication login console
description: Use this command to set the AAA authentication methods for console log ins. Configure mode
syntax: aaa authentication login console ((group LINE) | local | none)
no aaa authentication login console ((group LINE) | local | none)

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Use a server group list for authentication

parameters.name: LINE
parameters.description: Specify a space-separated list of up to 8 configured RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP server group names followed bylocalornoneor bothlocalandnone. The list can also include:

name: aaa authentication login default
description: Use this command to set the AAA authentication methods. Configure mode
syntax: aaa authentication login default ((group LINE) | local | none)
no aaa authentication login default ((group LINE) | local | none)

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Use a server group list for authentication

parameters.name: LINE
parameters.description: Specify a space-separated list of up to 8 configured RADIUS, TACACS+, or LDAP server group names followed bylocalornoneor bothlocalandnone. The list can also include:

name: aaa authentication login default fallback error
description: Use this command to enable fallback to local authentication for the default login if remote authentication is configured and all AAA servers are unreachable. None
syntax: aaa authentication login default fallback error local
no aaa authentication login default fallback error local
examples: (config)#aaa authentication login default fallback error local

name: aaa group server
description: Use this command to create a server group and enter server group configuration mode. Configure mode

name: aaa local authentication attempts max-fail
description: Use this command to set the number of unsuccessful authentication attempts before a user is locked out. Configure mode
syntax: no aaa local authentication attempts max-fail <1-25>

parameters.description: Range of number of unsuccessful authentication attempts

name: debug aaa
description: Use this command to display AAA debugging information. Executive mode and configure mode
syntax: debug aaa (aaa-requests | all | conf-events | errors | events | mts)
no debug aaa (aaa-requests | all | conf-events | errors | events | mts)

parameters.name: mts
parameters.description: AAA transmit and receive MTS packets

name: server
description: Use this command to add a server to a server group. RADlUS server group configure mode

name: show aaa
description: Use this command to display AAA server groups or user default role. Executive mode

name: show aaa accounting
description: Use this command to display AAA accounting configuration. None

name: show aaa authentication
description: Use this command to display AAA authentication configuration. None

name: show aaa authentication login
description: Use this command to display AAA authentication configuration for login default and login console. Executive mode

parameters.name: error-enable
parameters.description: Display setting for login failure messages

parameters.name: mschap
parameters.description: Display setting for Microsoft Challenge Handshake Authentication Protocol (MS-CHAP) authentication

name: show running-config aaa
description: Use this command to display AAA settings in the running configuration. Executive mode

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Display both configured and default settings
